aviation_incidents.headline: 威斯康辛州Piper JetProp墜毀造成六人死亡 飛行員曾通報結冰
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架Piper JetProp DLX於2026年10月13日在美國威斯康辛州墜毀，機上五名成人及一名兒童死亡。飛機墜落在威斯康辛州Dellona鎮、Wisconsin Dells附近的林地。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Piper JetProp crash in Wisconsin kills six; pilot reported icing
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Piper JetProp DLX crashed in Wisconsin on October 13, 2026, killing five adults and a child. The aircraft went down in a wooded area in the Town of Dellona, near Wisconsin Dells.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 蔣萬安盼與中央合作推動松山機場遷建
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安列席行政院會，會前表示將在會中說明、討論松山機場遷建，並就整體評估交換意見。他也表示，願意與中央共同努力推動遷移目標；目前談及的是遷建議題與合作目標，並非已完成遷建。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an Seeks Cooperation on Songshan Airport Relocation
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an attended an Executive Yuan meeting and said before it that Songshan Airport relocation would be explained and discussed there, with views exchanged on an overall assessment. He also said he was willing to work with the central government to pursue the relocation goal. His remarks described a goal for discussion and cooperation, not a completed relocation.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 中華航空更新輕旅行會員計畫，新增碳抵換點數回饋機制
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空股份有限公司表示，輕旅行會員計畫新增點數回饋機制。會員完成「環保旅程（Eco Travel）」碳抵換後，可獲得輕旅行點數；搭配其他挑戰項目累積達8點，即可享有購票優惠。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines adds points for Eco Travel offsets in updated program
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines said its Easy Travel membership program has added a points-reward mechanism. Members can earn Easy Travel points after completing a carbon offset through Eco Travel. When points accumulated with other challenge activities reach eight, members can receive ticket-purchase offers.

international_aviation.summary_en: BIRD Aerosystems has completed installation of its Airborne Missile Protection System (AMPS) on a Bombardier Global 7500 and received European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) certification. Ondas announced the certification on October 13, 2026.

international_aviation.headline: Horizon Air機師指控資方企業貪婪 於西雅圖與波伊西發動糾察
international_aviation.summary: Horizon Air機師指控僱主展現「管理不善與企業貪婪的模式」，並表示這已影響薪資與工作條件的協商。
international_aviation.headline_en: Horizon Air pilots accuse employer of 'corporate greed' as staff hold picket
international_aviation.summary_en: Horizon Air pilots have accused their employer of showing a "pattern of mismanagement and corporate greed" that has affected negotiations over wages and conditions.

international_aviation.headline: 英國航空今冬將以波音787執飛倫敦希斯洛至馬德里航線
international_aviation.summary: 英國航空將於今年冬季在倫敦希斯洛至馬德里巴拉哈斯的短程航線使用波音787客機。報導摘要指出，倫敦希斯洛是英國航空的主要樞紐，馬德里則是西班牙首都。
international_aviation.headline_en: British Airways to Use Boeing 787 on Heathrow–Madrid Route This Winter
international_aviation.summary_en: British Airways will fly the Boeing 787 on its short-haul route from its main hub at London Heathrow (LHR) to Madrid–Barajas this winter, according to Simple Flying’s summary. The summary identifies Madrid as Spain’s capital and describes it as a key short-haul route for the airline because it is home to oneworld partner Iberia.

international_aviation.headline: 日本航空訂購最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2 取代J-AIR E170與E190機隊
international_aviation.summary: 日本航空（JAL）於2026年10月14日宣佈，已訂購最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2，以取代旗下區域航空公司J-AIR的區域客機機隊。訂單包括16架確定訂購的飛機及10架選擇權，預計於2029會計年度開始交付。
international_aviation.headline_en: Japan Airlines orders up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 jets for J-AIR fleet replacement
international_aviation.summary_en: Japan Airlines (JAL) announced on October 14, 2026, that it has ordered up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 aircraft to replace the regional jet fleet of its subsidiary J-AIR. The order includes 16 firm aircraft and 10 options, with deliveries scheduled to begin in fiscal year 2029.

international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus says airlines will need 2.4 million new workers by 2045. The Simple Flying headline also says the aviation services sector will double, placing the workforce projection alongside the sector outlook.

international_aviation.summary: 阿聯酋航空將在三週後恢復休士頓的空中巴士A380航班。報導標題將這條不停站航線描述為17小時；摘要則指出，阿聯酋航空將恢復休士頓的A380航班服務。
